expo.name: TD IT Solution Insurance
expo.description: Protect and recover your valuable assets with monthly insurance plans and GPS-assisted recovery support.

infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: TD IT Solution Insurance sends theft recovery alerts, device status updates, and account notifications to help protect your registered assets.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TD IT Solution Insurance uses your location while the app is open to show where your registered smartphone is and help you recover it if lost or stolen.
